newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brasmotor still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brasmotor still a buy.

text.p: -- Banco Patrimonio, an associate of Salomon Brothers, said it reiterated its buy recommendation on shares of Brazilian household goods firm Brasmotor.
-- The bank also said it has analyzed the value of each of Brasmotor's major subsidiaries, in an effort to determine the "fair value" of Brasmotor as a holding company.
-- "According to our analysis, Brasmotor's fair value relative to its subsidiaries should be 1.125 billion reais," it said.

-- Patrimonio valued Brasmotor's investments in Multibras and Embraco at 1.05 billion and two million reais respectively and investments in other non-listed units at 24 million reais and said it holds 49 million reais in cash, the bank said.
-- Brasmotor's current market value is 963 million reais, which reflects a 17 percent discount to the company's relative fair value, the bank said.
-- Brasmotor's preferred share was off two reais at 373.00 reais and Multibras preferred was down 0.03 reais at 1.60 reais at noon/1500 gmt on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange.
-- Common voting shares of Brasmotor, Multibras and Embraco as well as Embraco preferred were untraded Thursday morning on the local bourse.
